remarks: Opportunity to own a beautifully maintained 4 bedroom, 3 full bath home offering over 2,400 square feet of living space in one of North Buffalo's most sought after locations. Just steps from Delaware Park and Hertel Avenue, you'll enjoy easy access to Buffalo's premier restaurants, shops, cafes, festivals, and everything this vibrant neighborhood has to offer. Inside, you'll find a perfect blend of character, comfort, and functionality with dramatic remote controlled skylights that fill the living spaces with natural light. The expansive primary suite serves as a private retreat, featuring vaulted ceilings, a walk in closet, and direct access to the porch. The kitchen offers granite countertops, soft close cabinetry, and a reverse osmosis water filtration system. Additional upgrades include a soft water system, tankless hot water heater, updated exterior siding, and a brand new complete tear off roof installed in 2026 with a transferable 20 year warranty, offering peace of mind for years to come. Homes offering this combination of size, updates, and walkability to both Delaware Park and Hertel Avenue don't come along often. Move in ready and easy to show, this is an excellent opportunity to own a spacious home in one of North Buffalo's most desirable neighborhoods.
